issues.description: Check name is inconsistent between PR description/CHANGELOG and the shipped directory/class identifier.
issues.detail: PR description references compute_image_publicly_shared while the directory, class, and metadata use compute_image_not_publicly_shared (CHANGELOG also disagrees). The CheckID is the contract callers, dashboards, and docs bind to. Pick one canonical name and propagate it across CHANGELOG, description, paths, and class before merge.

issues.description: getIamPolicy failures silently degrade to publicly_shared=False, turning auth errors into PASS findings.
issues.detail: In _get_images, when getIamPolicy raises (e.g., permission denied as test-image-3 simulates), the image is appended with publicly_shared=False and the check reports PASS. A security check that defaults to clean on verification failure is the wrong failure mode. Surface as UNKNOWN/MANUAL, skip the resource, or emit an error finding so PASS honestly means verified-not-public.

issues.description: Per-image getIamPolicy is serialized while every sibling collector in this file uses __threading_call__.
issues.detail: _get_images iterates project_ids and images sequentially, issuing one getIamPolicy per image. Other collections in compute_service.py thread over projects/regions/zones. Wall-clock scales as N * RTT for projects with many images, and the inconsistency reads as not having read the surrounding file. Reuse the existing threaded helper.

issues.description: Test asserts publicly_shared=False for the IAM-policy exception case, pinning the leaky failure semantics.
issues.detail: test-image-3 raises in getIamPolicy and the test asserts publicly_shared is False, conflating verified-not-public with verification-failed. This locks in the current bad-taste behavior and makes correcting the failure path (see the IAM swallow finding) a test-breaking change. Update the test to expect unknown/skip semantics.

issues.description: Image ADT is thin: stores only a derived boolean and omits self_link/location/binding context found on sibling models.
issues.detail: The Image model drops which role(s) and members granted public access and lacks a self_link/region carried by Disk and Instance. Findings on shared images become hard to act on across projects, and remediation/audit consumers must re-query. Add public_bindings (or members) plus a resource URI to match module convention.

issues.description: images().list scope and filter are undocumented, risking confusion about custom-vs-public catalog coverage.
issues.detail: images().list(project=project_id) returns the project's own images, but the description claims custom-only without a stated invariant or filter (e.g., deprecated.state). Add a one-line comment explaining why project-scoped list suffices (Google-managed images live in separate projects) so future readers don't expand the scope or add spurious filters.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small, focused check that needs work before merge. Two P1 issues dominate: the CheckID name is inconsistent between the PR description/CHANGELOG and the shipped directory/class, and getIamPolicy failures silently produce PASS findings, which is the wrong failure mode for a security check. The serialized per-image IAM calls also diverge from the threaded style used by every other collector in compute_service.py. Secondary concerns include a thin Image ADT that discards binding context, a test that pins the leaky exception behavior, and an undocumented image-listing scope. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — fix the name, the failure semantics, and the threading before landing.
